body:
Every human NPC spawned with hardcoded arrogance=50 -- since panic_arrogance_max()=15 and engage_arrogance_min()=70, this meant WS_PANIC and WS_ENGAGE were mathematically unreachable in live play, always landing in SILENCING/DENIAL. server_spawn_npcs now rolls server_roll100() per human instead of a fixed constant, reusing the existing seeded server RNG. 4/4 live scratch-harness assertions (varied spawn, PANIC reachable, ENGAGE reachable, old-50-confirmed-broken), bazel 36/36 green, real server+client builds clean, ASan/UBSan clean. BIG_O/NORTHSTAR.md §22, closes §11 item 5.

⚓ ☃
title: Real per-NPC arrogance variety -- PANIC and ENGAGE can finally fire live
